firewall.description: API bodies carry the media type their handler reads
firewall.expression: (http.request.uri.path eq "/api/contact" and not any(http.request.headers["content-type"][*] wildcard "application/json*")) or (http.request.uri.path eq "/api/csp-report" and not any(http.request.headers["content-type"][*] wildcard "application/csp-report*") and not any(http.request.headers["content-type"][*] wildcard "application/reports+json*") and not any(http.request.headers["content-type"][*] wildcard "application/json*"))

firewall.description: The preview review proxy never answers on the production hosts
PHP, WordPress, dotenv, and git probes
firewall.expression: (ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".php") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/.env") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/.git") or http.request.uri.path eq "/xmlrpc.php")

rateLimit.description: 15 API requests per 10 seconds per IP
